subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Which open fix PR should be the canonical landing path for the empty-error-retry issue?
rationale: This PR appears viable, but two other open PRs target the same canonical issue and landing more than one would create duplicate retry-state changes.

options.title: Make this PR canonical
options.body: Use this branch as the canonical candidate after rebase and exact-head checks because it preserves cumulative metadata while adding an explicit current-attempt retry gate and covers the prior same-attempt blocker.

options.title: Prefer a sibling PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97890 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97899 only if maintainers prefer its diff shape and proof after review.

options.title: Write a maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Pause the contributor candidates if maintainers want a different owner-boundary shape for retry metadata or broader session-state cleanup.

recommendation.title: Make this PR canonical
recommendation.body: Use this branch as the canonical candidate after rebase and exact-head checks because it preserves cumulative metadata while adding an explicit current-attempt retry gate and covers the prior same-attempt blocker.
